content: A ku ɡɑri ɡere kɑ sɛndɑru. A ku mɑɑ Gusunɔ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ kɑ sɛndɑru. Domi u wɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔllɔ mɑ wunɛ ɑ wɑ̃ɑ temɔ. A ku de wunɛn ɡɑri yi n dɑbi.
Geemɑ, bwisiku dɑbinɑ nu rɑ kɑ dosusu nɛ. Gɑri sɑɑri dɑbiru sɔɔrɑ mɑɑ ɡɑri kɑnkɑm ɡerubu wɑ̃ɑ.
À n Gusunɔ ɡɑ̃ɑnun nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ, ɑ ku de n tɛ ɑ kɑ tu yibiɑ. Domi Gusunɔ u ku rɑ ɡɑri bɑkɑsun mɛm kɑ̃. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ de ɑ wunɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛru yibiɑ te ɑ kuɑ.
Ye kɑɑ kɑ nɔɔ mwɛɛru ko ɑ kun yibie, n burɑm bo ɑ ku tu ko.
A ku de wunɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛ te, tu nun torɑsiɑ, kpɑ ɑ yɑ̃ku kowo sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ dɑɑ kɑ bɑɑruwɑ. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ kɑɑ de wunɛn ɡɑrin sɔ̃ Gusunɔn mɔru yu se kpɑ u wunɛn sɔmburu kɑm koosiɑ.
Gɑri yì n dɑbiɑ, yi ku rɑ n ɑrufɑɑni mɔ. Nɡe mɛyɑ dosusu sù n mɑɑ dɑbiɑ, su ku rɑ n ɑrufɑɑni mɔ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ Gusunɔ nɑsio.
Dɑm dɔrebu
À n wɑ tem ɡɑm bɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ dɑm dɔremɔ, bɑ ǹ nùn win ɡem wɛ̃ɛmɔ, ɑ ku de yu nun biti ko. A de ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ wiruɡii wɑ̃ɑ wi u wiruɡii ɡoo kere. Mɛyɑ wiruɡii mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ wi u be yiru ye kpuro kere.
Adɑmɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu nu wɑ̃ɑ be kpuron sɔ̃. Niyɑ, tem mɑrum, bɑɑ kɑ mɑm sinɑ bokon tii.
Dukiɑn ɑrufɑɑni sɑriru
Wi u ɡobi kĩɑ, yi ku rɑ nùn turi. Wi u mɑɑ dukiɑ kĩɑ, u ku rɑ yen ɑrufɑɑni di. Nɑ wɑ mɑ yen tii yɑ tubum sɛ̃.
Mi dukiɑ yɑ kpɛ̃ɑ, miyɑ diobu bɑ rɑ dɑbie. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑrufɑɑni yerɑ̀ wi u ye mɔ u wɑɑmɔ ye sɔɔ, mɑ kun mɔ yen wɑɑ bi tɔnɑ.
Sɔm kowo bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ u dĩɑnu mɔ nu kpɑ̃, nu ǹ kpɑ̃, u rɑ dweeyewɑ kɑ bɔri yɛndu. Adɑmɑ dukiɑɡiin deburɑ ku rɑ de u dweeye.
Nɑ kɔ̃sɑ ɡɑɑ wɑ hɑnduniɑ ye sɔɔ. Yeyɑ, ɡoo wi u dukiɑ beruɑ ye yɑ koo kɑ nùn nɔni swɑ̃ɑru nɑɑwɑ.
Dukiɑ ye, yɑ rɑ kɑm kowɑ wɑhɑlɑ ɡɑɑ sɔɔ kpɑ u kun mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ sɑnɑm mɛ u bii mɑrɑ.
U koo ɡbiwɑ tereru nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ nùn mɑrɑ. U ǹ kpɛ̃ u win sɔmburun ɑre ɡɛɛ suɑ.
U koo ɡbiwɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ kɑ nùn mɑrɑ. Yerɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sɑ bɑkɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑrufɑɑni yerɑ̀ u wɑ mi win sɔmburu sɔɔ. Tɑ kuɑwɑ kɑm dirum.
Yen biru, u rɑ diwɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ kpɑ u n wɑ̃ɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu kɑ wɑhɑlɑ kɑ mɔru bɑkɑ sɔɔ win wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ru kpuro sɔɔ.
Ye nɑ wɑ n burɑm bo kpuro tɔnun sɔ̃ yerɑ, u di u nɔ kpɑ u nuku dobu ko win sɔmburun ɑre sɔɔ win wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ru sɔɔ te Gusunɔ u nùn burɑ. Domi yerɑ u mɔ mi.
Gusunɔ ù n tɔnu dukiɑ wɛ̃, mɑ u derɑ u ye dendimɔ, mɑ u nuku dobu mɔ̀ win sɔmburun ɑren sɔ̃, yeni yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔn kɛ̃ru.
Adɑmɑ yɛ̃ro u ku rɑ yɑɑye mɑ win wɑ̃ɑru tɑ ǹ dɛ̃u yèn sɔ̃ Gusunɔ u nùn nuku dobu yibiɑ.
